name: SEISHINBYOU-PSYCHOSIS
source:
Kojirou, a young boy of Christian Faith, who overcomes a trial. His reward is losing his faith in God and placing it within his best friend, who saved his life, Sakuma.

For a time, Sakuma plays along, pretending to be God and allowing Kojirou to pray to him; however, the vision begins to fade.
